items.title: A surjection from the module to a fusion product and the resulting lower bound for its dimension
items.author: Bhimarthi Ravinder
items.work: Demazure Modules, Chari-Venkatesh Modules and Fusion Products
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement exhibits a well-defined surjective map from the cyclic module attached to one pair of parameters onto a fusion product of a Demazure module and copies of the evaluation module of the fundamental representation, and deduces the lower bound for its dimension displayed with the article's label dimg (author proposition without an author label, statement at source lines 659-668). The proof (source lines 669-698) reduces to the presentation of the source module, records the relations satisfied in the tensor product of the factors, and transports them to the fusion product by the lemma labelled f2 to verify the remaining relations (proof lines 670-697). The transport of the annihilation relations through the fusion product is the content. H2.
